segments.name: nav_to_invoices

inputParameters.name: portal_url
inputParameters.description: Base URL of the Hangar Supply vendor portal

segments.deterministic: async (page, parameters) => { const baseUrl = String(parameters.portal_url || '').trim().replace(/\/+$/, ''); const targetUrl = baseUrl.endsWith('/invoices') ? baseUrl : `${baseUrl}/invoices`; await page.goto(targetUrl); return {}; }

segments.name: extract_invoices
segments.prompt:
Inspect the page at {{portal_url}}/invoices. If the page shows a sign-in form instead of invoices, stop and fail with the message "signed out". Otherwise, read every row of the Invoices table which has columns: Invoice #, Invoice Date, Due Date, Description, Amount, and Status. Return invoices_json: a JSON array with one object per row, sorted newest first, each with fields:
- number: the Invoice # exactly as shown (e.g. HS-10480)
- issued: the Invoice Date written as YYYY-MM-DD (page shows MM/DD/YYYY)
- due: the Due Date written as YYYY-MM-DD
- description: the Description text
- amount: the Amount without the $ sign or commas, with two decimals (e.g. 4215.50)
- currency: "USD"
- status: the Status in lower case: paid, open or overdue.

outputParameters.name: invoices_json
outputParameters.description: JSON array of invoice records, newest first

segments.deterministic: async (page, parameters) => { const passwordInput = page.locator('input[type="password"], form[action*="login"], form[action*="signin"]').first(); const isPasswordVisible = await passwordInput.isVisible({ timeout: 1500 }).catch(() => false); if (isPasswordVisible) throw new Error("signed out"); const table = page.locator('table').first(); await table.waitFor({ state: 'attached', timeout: 10000 }); await table.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded({ timeout: 500 }).catch(() => {}); const data = await page.evaluate(() => { const isPass = !!document.querySelector('input[type="password"]'); const bodyText = (document.body?.innerText || '').toLowerCase(); if (isPass || (bodyText.includes('sign in') && !document.querySelector('table'))) return { signedOut: true, rows: [] }; const tableEl = document.querySelector('table'); if (!tableEl) return { signedOut: false, rows: null }; const trs = Array.from(tableEl.querySelectorAll('tr')); if (!trs.length) return { signedOut: false, rows: [] }; let headerIdx = -1; const colMap = { number: 0, issued: 1, due: 2, description: 3, amount: 4, status: 5 }; for (let i = 0; i < trs.length; i++) { const cells = Array.from(trs[i].querySelectorAll('th, td')).map(c => (c.innerText || '').trim().toLowerCase()); if (cells.some(c => c.includes('invoice') || c.includes('amount') || c.includes('status'))) { headerIdx = i; cells.forEach((c, idx) => { if (c.includes('invoice #') || (c.includes('invoice') && c.includes('#')) || c === 'invoice' || c === 'invoice #') colMap.number = idx; else if (c.includes('invoice date') || c.includes('issued') || (c.includes('date') && !c.includes('due'))) colMap.issued = idx; else if (c.includes('due date') || c.includes('due')) colMap.due = idx; else if (c.includes('description') || c.includes('desc')) colMap.description = idx; else if (c.includes('amount') || c.includes('total')) colMap.amount = idx; else if (c.includes('status')) colMap.status = idx; }); break; } } const startIdx = headerIdx >= 0 ? headerIdx + 1 : 1; function formatDate(str) { if (!str) return ''; const t = str.trim(); const m1 = t.match(/^(\d{1,2})[\/\-](\d{1,2})[\/\-](\d{4})$/); if (m1) return `${m1[3]}-${m1[1].padStart(2, '0')}-${m1[2].padStart(2, '0')}`; const m2 = t.match(/^(\d{4})[\/\-](\d{1,2})[\/\-](\d{1,2})$/); if (m2) return `${m2[1]}-${m2[2].padStart(2, '0')}-${m2[3].padStart(2, '0')}`; return t; } const items = []; for (let i = startIdx; i < trs.length; i++) { const tds = Array.from(trs[i].querySelectorAll('td')); if (tds.length === 0) continue; const num = (tds[colMap.number]?.innerText || '').trim(); if (!num) continue; const rawIssued = (tds[colMap.issued]?.innerText || '').trim(); const rawDue = (tds[colMap.due]?.innerText || '').trim(); const desc = (tds[colMap.description]?.innerText || '').trim(); const rawAmount = (tds[colMap.amount]?.innerText || '').replace(/[^0-9.-]+/g, ''); const parsedAmount = parseFloat(rawAmount); const amount = isNaN(parsedAmount) ? '' : parsedAmount.toFixed(2); const rawStatus = (tds[colMap.status]?.innerText || '').trim().toLowerCase(); let status = 'open'; if (rawStatus.includes('paid')) status = 'paid'; else if (rawStatus.includes('overdue')) status = 'overdue'; else if (rawStatus.includes('open')) status = 'open'; items.push({ number: num, issued: formatDate(rawIssued), due: formatDate(rawDue), description: desc, amount: amount, currency: 'USD', status: status }); } items.sort((a, b) => (b.issued || '').localeCompare(a.issued || '')); return { signedOut: false, rows: items }; }); if (data.signedOut) throw new Error("signed out"); if (!data.rows) throw new Error("Missing required output 'invoices_json' from extract_invoices: table element not found"); return { invoices_json: JSON.stringify(data.rows) }; }
